body.statement: Under the compatibility regime in the fixed-interior Gaussian-witness definition, for every \(n\) satisfying \(\bar T/\sqrt n\leq\min\{a_{\mathrm{int}}/2,(1-a_{\mathrm{int}})/2\}\) and \(2a_{\mathrm{int}}\bar T/\sqrt n+\bar T^2/n\leq1-a_{\mathrm{int}}^2-\delta_0\), uniformly over \(t\in[-\bar T,\bar T]\), the coefficient \(b_{n,t}=a_{\mathrm{int}}+t/\sqrt n\) lies in \([a_{\mathrm{int}}/2,(1+a_{\mathrm{int}})/2]\subset(0,1)\), \[(3-\sqrt5)/2\leq\lambda_{\min}(\Sigma(b_{n,t}))\leq\lambda_{\max}(\Sigma(b_{n,t}))\leq(3+\sqrt5)/2,\] \(E_{P_{n,t}^{\mathrm{int}}}[\|W_i\|_2^8]\leq1920\{(3+\sqrt5)/2\}^4\), and \(\sigma_{P_{n,t}^{\mathrm{int}}}(\theta)^2=4(\theta^2+b_{n,t}^2)(1+\theta^2)\in[a_{\mathrm{int}}^2,100]\) for every \(\theta\in[-2,2]\). Moreover, \(\beta=(1,0)^{\prime}\), \(\alpha=(0,b_{n,t})^{\prime}\), \(\theta_0=\check\theta=0\), \(\gamma=(0,b_{n,t})^{\prime}\), and \(\delta(P_{n,t}^{\mathrm{int}})=1-b_{n,t}^2\geq\delta_0\). The raw endpoints are therefore defined and \(\Theta_I(P_{n,t}^{\mathrm{int}})=[-\sqrt{1-b_{n,t}^2},\sqrt{1-b_{n,t}^2}]\subset(-1,1)\), so \(\operatorname{dist}(\Theta_I(P_{n,t}^{\mathrm{int}}),\partial K)>1\); no \(K\)-truncation occurs. Hence \(P_{n,t}^{\mathrm{int}}\in\mathcal P^{\mathrm{int}}(\delta_0)\) along the full compact path. The experiment \(\{P_{n,t}^{\mathrm{int}}:t\in[-\bar T,\bar T]\}\) is locally asymptotically normal and mutually contiguous.
body.justification: The explicit coefficient, eigenvalue, moment, score-variance, relevance, slack, and parameter-margin bounds certify that the regular LAN path belongs to the maintained fixed-interior class.
body.gap: The contact converse needs a distinct regular comparator experiment; no published leaky-IV result states this uniform fixed-interior path membership calculation.
body.consumer: The verified path makes the root-\(n\) lower half of the minimax frontier a claim over the maintained model rather than over an informal Gaussian analogue.
